ADDITIVE IR: AllocEvent (new/object/array + sorted referenced_names), UnaryEvent (delete), FunctionRecord.entry_declared. IR-internal, serde-defaulted; no schema/DTO change.

ENTRY: scanner reads package.json main/bin (string/object/array) + in-source require.main===module / import.meta.url guards -> entry_declared; aggregator ladder: script HIGH / conventional script MEDIUM / lib-root MEDIUM / unknown-entry LOW. No package.json type analysis.
DISCOVERY/RESOLVER/INSTRUMENT implemented B2-W1: global dir skips, JS-only min/size skips, relative resolver (bare=external, miss=null), JS alloc family + throw error path.

SINGLE-FILE/CLASS LIMITS: single-file *.min.*/.bundle.js and unsupported .ts/.mts/.cts/.tsx/.d.* are skipped silently (unknown ext keeps C fallback); non-arrow class field initializers and class_static_block are not event-scanned.

Vendored/minified JS noise; mitigated in B2-W1 by global dir skips + JS-only name/size cap (integration-locked).
No type information -> type-aware rules impossible; syntactic tier stated honestly and limitations published.

.d.ts skip hides type-only modules (imports become unresolved-internal data-only); unlabeled minified <2 MiB still parsed; extensions case-sensitive.
